You use the simple present tense to talk about something that is true in the present, a habit, or a general condition of a subject.
However, many companies do not know how to get, use, or structure those IS.

Additionally, a company does not need a big investment to get the appropriate IS tool but an investment for a critical analysis of business processes in the present to establish a strategy for the future.

You use the auxiliary verbs do and does along with the particle not, to make negative sentences in the simple present.
You will usually find these two words in their contracted form when you read a dialogue or any informal text. When you write a formal text, you use the non-contracted form:

Do not = Don't
Does not = Doesn't

Check the structure of a negative statement in simple present:

Subject + do/does + not + verb in the base form + complement.

Remember that the verb in base form does not change depending on the person. Instead, the auxiliary do or does is the one that changes.

Does not: We use doesn't for the third person singular.

It does not provide enough information for the business.
She does not analyze possible IT apps for the business.
He does not play with company values.

Do not: We use don't for any other than the third person singular. Let's see some examples:

I don't deny the importance of information systems.
You don't like defective computer applications.
They do not use the appropriate tools to improve business.
We do not concentrate on useless systems.

images.text: The Information systems (IS) have multiple uses in today's world because many entrepreneurs look for effective tools to promote their business. However, many companies do not know how to get, use, or structure those IS. Information systems not only enhance business but provide an alternative to organizing business processes, make decisions or take actions in emergencies. Additionally, a company does not need a big investment to get the appropriate IS tool but an investment for a critical analysis of business processes in the present to establish a strategy for the future.

We don't have to go so far to understand how to make or diagram a business process analysis. We simply have to analyze the existing state of the business process, which is the As-Is process, integrated by a series of steps to identify and describe shareholders performance and roles. As a consequence, the company does not need more than the As-Is process results to redesign the business in the To-Be process and get a perspective of how the business will work. So, this last one is not accurate if it doesn't consider the As-is process.

The purpose of the As-is process is describing the current state of a company. Take as an example the process to pay a credit card bill. Users have to take a turn in a long bank line. However, with the quick extension of information systems in computers, customers don't have to wait in a line for a long time. There is the possibility of making a faster payment by using the fingerprint or any kind of middleware system. If a business works along with the information systems, it can identify business difficulties in the present to set up future plans.
